text: Across all three tiers, Mara Voss built real work for Hartwell Regional Utilities: a hardening pass and one Sentinel rule, then multi-source detection and a firewall fix, then a zero-trust pilot, dual-cloud identity, automation, and a genuine audit discrepancy, found and fixed.

That discrepancy wasn't a detour. The dual-check automation existed specifically so two independent methods could disagree and surface a real gap. In Lesson 15, something real did surface. That's the architecture working, not failing.

From here, the real path runs toward security architecture or GRC leadership — deeper review work, formal program ownership, and credentials like Security Plus, CySA Plus, and eventually CISSP, alongside the work itself, not instead of it.

A genuinely senior version of this program would still push further: continuous cross-tool reconciliation, the fixed methodology extended to every segment, and a formal break-glass policy with automatic expiry built in. Naming that honestly is itself the job.
